development_replay.source: Reproduce with run_offline.py evaluate-grounded on each pinned benchmark; older per-case replay files are ignored run outputs.

v8_exploratory.limitation: The first policy was changed after replay exposed six wrong accepted pronoun/vague-text plans in older benchmarks. v8 is not a clean holdout for the revised policy.

sft_v1_admission.failure: The model proposal dropped an extra emailing operation and the older gate admitted typing.

reason: V9 is a small agent-authored offline set. The grounded grammar has no physical vision, target registration, controller authorization, or independent typing evidence, and zero observed false plans is not a general safety guarantee.
